name: Wake listener help
description: Help mode entries for the Wake listener plugin (help@1): the settings tab, the banner light and the spoken flows.
author: Brett

entries.title: Wake listener
entries.text: The console listens for a wake phrase you set here (several allowed), then takes one command: any console action, plugin command, pipeline command or control@1 target, by voice. A command with missing fields becomes a spoken wizard that asks for each one and confirms. 'Approve' reviews everything waiting on axHub one call at a time.
entries.more: The switch closes the microphone everywhere this console is open. On the console Android app the recognizer runs on the device (offline); in a browser it is the browser's own. The light on the banner shows what the listener is doing: grey = off, green = waiting for the wake phrase, amber = heard it and waiting for a command, accent = a wizard is waiting for your answer, red = an error with the reason. Replies are spoken through the agent voice when it is installed, else the device voice.
entries.tryIt: Say your wake phrase, wait for the chime, then say 'approve'.

entries.title: Mic light
entries.text: Lit while the console listens for its wake phrase. Tap it to switch the listener on or off.
entries.more: Grey: off. Green: idle, waiting for the wake phrase. Amber: awake, say a command. Accent: a wizard or the approvals review is waiting for an answer. Red: the recognizer stopped; the label says why.

entries.title: Say a phrase without the microphone
entries.text: Runs a phrase as if the mic heard it after the wake phrase: from the settings tab's Try it box, or from the API (REST, MCP, CLI, AmberX) as the console action wake-listener.heard:<phrase>.
